title: V11 Agent Error Ledger Line
description: Schema for ONE line of ~/.agent-metrics/agent-errors.jsonl. Appended by sync-tasks (Layer 2: lite review, V11.15), wave-review-attribute (Layer 3: wave review, V11.20), and swarm-review-attribute (Layer 4: swarm review, V11.20). One line per error, attributed to the executing agent. V11.20 adds found_by_layer, caller_kind, task_id_inferred, attribution_key for cross-layer unified scorecards. All four new fields are ADDITIVE: legacy entries without them default to found_by_layer=lite, caller_kind=unknown, task_id_inferred=false, attribution_key absent.

agent_id.description: Executing agent the error is attributed to. Layer 2 (lite): from artifacts.review.agent_id, else task-state active_agent_id. Layer 3/4 (wave/swarm): resolved via v11_resolve_file_to_task (file→task→agent). Falls back to 'unattributed' when no task touched the file.

error_type.description: Error class. Tight enum (V11.20) prevents misspellings across the four review layers. false_provenance is a historical Layer 2 value retained for backward compat with V11.15 entries.

found_by.description: Reviewer agent id. Layer 2: adversarial-lite-reviewer. Layer 3: adversarial-reviewer. Layer 4: swarm-review:<lens-name>.

fixed.description: True if adversarial-lite-fixer resolved it and re-verify passed (Layer 2 only — wave/swarm findings are advisory, no auto-fix)

escalated.description: True if CRITICAL — escalated to orchestrator, not auto-fixed

trace_id.description: Carried from artifacts.trace_id for cross-hop correlation

found_by_layer.description: V11.20/V11.21: which review layer caught this error. lite=legacy V11.15 per-task adversarial-lite (aliases to lite_adversarial at read time). lite_self=V11.21 self-review (Layer A: implementing agent emits verdict). lite_adversarial=V11.21 paired adversarial-lite-reviewer (Layer B). wave=5-lens adversarial-reviewer (V11.6+). swarm=parallel multi-lens audit (V11.5). runtime=harness/test failure (future). Legacy entries written before V11.21 use 'lite'; consumers must treat 'lite' as 'lite_adversarial' for backward-compat reporting.

caller_kind.description: V11.20: was the executing agent the main orchestrator session or a spawned subagent? Resolved by v11_caller_kind from V11_SUBAGENT env (subagent) or V11_PARENT_SESSION_ID==V11_SESSION_ID (orchestrator). Legacy entries default to 'unknown'.

task_id_inferred.description: V11.20: true when task_id was resolved via file→task mapping (wave/swarm paths). false when task_id was explicit in the verdict (lite path). Legacy entries default to false.

attribution_key.description: V11.20: SHA256 hex digest of '|'.join(project, task_id, file, line, error_id). Deterministic. Used by wave/swarm attribute scripts for idempotent dedup via ~/.agent-metrics/attribution-keys.jsonl. Absent on legacy lite entries.

executor_kind.description: V11.21: For lite-layer entries, distinguishes self-review (Layer A, agent reviews its own output in TaskUpdate(completed) payload) from adversarial-lite review (Layer B, paired adversarial-lite-reviewer agent). Orthogonal to caller_kind (which describes session: orchestrator vs subagent). Optional — absent on non-lite layers and on pre-V11.21 lite entries (those use found_by_layer='lite' which read-time aliases to lite_adversarial).

attribution_degraded.description: V11.30: true when the writer could not determine the executing agent and agent_id fell back to 'unknown' (metadata.agent absent/null on the reviewable task). Emitted by sync-tasks Layer A actuation on self-review synthetic markers. Optional — absent on entries written before V11.30.
